Subject: Global POC kickoff — rotating deep-dive scheduling

Hi Natalie and Tom,

Thanks again for agreeing to run a POC with Redwood. We want to lock in a kickoff + hands-on working session focused on: prompt review, routing/variant tests, and an initial load test so we get measurable throughput numbers early. We also want this first session to establish a rotating cadence that alternates times so US/EU/APAC teams can attend live.

Proposed session windows (pick one or tell us constraints):
- Option A: Tue 2026-03-23 09:00–10:30 PDT (Tue 2026-03-23 17:00–18:30 CET; Wed 2026-03-24 01:00–02:30 JST)
- Option B: Wed 2026-03-24 07:00–08:30 PDT (Wed 2026-03-24 16:00–17:30 CET; Thu 2026-03-25 00:00–01:30 JST)
- Option C: Thu 2026-03-25 15:00–16:30 CET (Thu 2026-03-25 07:00–08:30 PDT; Fri 2026-03-25 23:00–00:30 JST)

Agenda (draft, attached as POC-Agenda.pdf):
- 15m: introductions & success criteria
- 40m: hands-on prompt review + routing test (team live editing)
- 20m: load test run (short steady-state run) + observability checks
- 15m: next steps & rotating cadence plan

Attachments: POC-Agenda.pdf, Network-Prep-Checklist.xlsx, Prelim-Load-Plan.csv (see attached). Please confirm:
- Which option works for your team?
- Who from Acme should we include for the network checks and load tests (SRE / infra contact)?
- Any blackout dates in late Mar?

We can also split the kickoff across two shorter sessions if that helps for APAC. Once we pick a slot I’ll send a calendar invite and a short pre-req checklist.

—Sergio

Happy to run the load test. Confirming availability: Wed 2026-03-24 06:30–09:30 PDT works for me (that’s Wed 2026-03-24 14:00–17:00 CET / Wed 2026-03-25 22:30–01:30 IST — please note the late IST window is okay for me this once).

Plan highlights (Prelim-Load-Plan.csv attached):
- 10-minute ramp to 20 RPS, 15-minute steady-state at 15–20 RPS, 5-minute cooldown
- Monitor token latency p50/p95, KV cache hit rate, GPU utilization per model shard
- Run with the routing policy set to prefer quantized model variant (we’ll switch to full-precision if we see quality regressions)

I’ll prepare the test harness and a short runbook for the SRE to follow during the session.
